briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate frontier race as US tightens chip export controls

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with new model releases from OpenAI and xAI while regulatory pressures mount on compute exports. US-China tensions dominate strategic discussions amid record quarterly funding.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning capabilities; xAI launched Grok-3; DeepSeek-V3 achieved strong benchmarks. Meta's Llama 4 open weights update expected next week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce new $15B data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls meaningfully slow China's frontier model progress before 2027?
